The structure of NaMnO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (Na₂Mn₂O₆) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral coordination with six O neighbors at 1.9562 Å, while Na centers have eight O neighbors at 2.5299–2.707 Å; O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by two Mn and two Na neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Mn octahedra, and both corner- and face-sharing between Mn octahedra and Na 8-vertex polyhedra.
